search_updates.claim: it has not formally adopted Sharia criminal provisions
search_updates.found: HRW 'The Extension of Shari'a to Criminal Law in Nigeria' (Oct 2004) names the twelve adopting states — Bauchi, Borno, Gombe, Jigawa, Kaduna, Kano, Katsina, Kebbi, Niger, Sokoto, Yobe, Zamfara — Adamawa is NOT among them; claim stands, but the record cites no source doing that work
